content.text: {"core": "Breakthrough removes a structure that no longer holds. At Creation, the point where finished things pass out into the world, its work is the last clearing before something is released — the break that lets the built thing leave clean. Unacknowledged, the breaking still happens but goes uncredited: the thing goes out carrying a crack no one named, and the flaw ships with it.", "sheetLine": "The break did its work unseen; what left the door still carries the unnamed crack."}
